movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms swing up and down or side to side in time with the beat.
movement_profile.footwork: Repeated inward and outward sliding of feet; T-step and running man variations.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Typically solo improvisation, moving within a small area.
movement_profile.posture: Upright with a focus on balance and stability.

signature_moves.description: A heel-toe pivot movement forming a T-shape with the feet.
signature_moves.name: T-step

signature_moves.description: A sliding jump sequence that mimics walking in place.
signature_moves.name: Running man

music_profile.musical_form: Electronic dance music (Acid house, Trance, Hardstyle)
music_profile.sound_description: Fast-paced, repetitive electronic beats with heavy basslines and synthesized melodies characteristic of rave music.

basic_steps: T-step: Pivot on one foot while sliding the other in a heel-toe motion.
Running man: A two-step sequence creating the illusion of walking in place.
Arm movement: Coordinated swinging of arms in time with the beat.
teaching.formation: Typically performed solo, though group 'crews' are common.
teaching.level_notes: Difficulty is intermediate; requires balance and coordination of footwork and arm movement.
